actions.script: if (!ec.user.hasPermission('MONITOR_EVAL')) { ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('This needs the MONITOR_EVAL permission')); return } ec.service.sync().name('update#moqui.agent.AgentScorerAttach').parameters({attachId, thruDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp}).disableAuthz().call()

canEdit = ec.user.hasPermission('MONITOR_EVAL') const num = v => v == null ? null : v.toNumber ? v.toNumber() : Number(v) const now = Date.now(), live = a => a.thruDate == null || Date.parse(String(a.thruDate)) > now const names = {}; for (const s of scorerList) names[s.scorerId] = s.scorerName || s.scorerId liveList = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.agent.AgentScorerAttach').disableAuthz().list()).filter(a => a.agentId && live(a)) .map(a => Object.assign(a.getMap(), {scorerName: names[a.scorerId] || a.scorerId, rate: Math.round(num(a.samplingRate) * 100) + '%'})) agentOptions = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.agent.AgentDefinition').disableAuthz().list()).map(a => ({value: a.agentId, label: a.agentName || a.agentId}))

label.text: A scorer gives an output a score from 0 to 1 and says why. Service: code you write (a service with input, output, groundTruth, runId, config in and score, reason out). Judge: a model grades by the rubric, using the eval-judge feature's model when one is bound in System › LLM. Human: a person scores.

A scorer attached to an agent scores that share of the agent's completed runs, chosen by run ID, every five minutes from now on. Live runs have no expected output, so use a judge, or a service scorer whose config names what to look for (Contains: {"terms": [...]}, Called tool: {"tools": [...]}). Judge scorers cost a model call each.
